blindSummary: This state/province is the only one in the country with a standing criminal ban on gender-expressive performance: a 2023 law criminalises "male or female impersonation" in public or where a child might be present — settled law after a federal appeals court reversed the ruling that had struck it down (July 2024) and the country's supreme court declined to hear the case (Feb 2025), so it is enforceable against a visitor presenting in drag. A 2019 amendment widened the indecent-exposure statute; 7.8 killings per 100k trans women/yr, above the country's general homicide rate. Local risk is below the country-wide average.
